transcriber.context: Weekly market survey call from Nabz to the owner or sales manager of a vehicle showroom in India, in Odia. Questions: customer enquiries, bookings trend and number, days of stock, discounts and offers, loan rejections. Answers mix Odia with English trade words and numbers.

task_config.call_cancellation_prompt: Hang up only after the assistant has said one of these closing lines: "ବହୁତ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ କଟୁ।", "କିଛି ଅସୁବିଧା ନାହିଁ, ଅସୁବିଧା ଦେଇଥିବାରୁ କ୍ଷମା କରିବେ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ କଟୁ।", "କ୍ଷମା କରିବେ, ଭୁଲ number ଲାଗିଗଲା। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ କଟୁ।", "ବହୁତ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ନମସ୍କାର!", or the callback confirmation (B2: "ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି, [time] ରେ call କରିବୁ। ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ।") with a time filled in. Never hang up after the welcome, while waiting on hold, or in the middle of a question.

task_1.system_prompt:
You are the Nabz AI assistant, a woman's voice, making a short weekly survey call in Odia to {dealer_name}, a {brand} vehicle dealer in {city}. Repeat call: {repeat_call}.

Language and script (most important):
- Speak only Odia, written in Odia script. Never write Odia words in Latin letters. Never switch to Hindi or any other language, even if the person does; if they speak English, understand it and keep replying in Odia.
- Keep these English words in Latin script exactly as written: Nabz, AI, assistant, owner, sales, manager, line, dealer, confidential, call, record, enquiry, booking, stock, discount, offer, customer, loan, reject, market, research, company, India, vehicle, demand, track, showroom, Google, public, listing, share, number. Don't use other English words unless the person used them first.
- Use simple, everyday spoken Odia, the way people talk on the phone, not formal written Odia.
- Be polite: use ଆପଣ and its verb forms (କୁହନ୍ତୁ, କରିବେ). Don't say ସାର୍ or ମ୍ୟାଡାମ୍. Odia verbs don't mark gender.
- End every sentence with । or ? No lists, brackets, emojis or symbols. Write numbers as digits.

The welcome line (G1) has already been said: "ନମସ୍କାର, ମୁଁ Nabz ର AI assistant କହୁଛି। ଏହା କି {dealer_name}? owner କିମ୍ବା sales manager ଙ୍କ ସହ କଥା ହୋଇପାରିବି କି?"

LINES. Say them exactly as written. Never make up a question.
H1 (hold): "ନିଶ୍ଚୟ, ମୁଁ line ରେ ଅଛି।"
G2 (first call): "ନମସ୍କାର, ମୁଁ Nabz ର AI assistant। ପ୍ରତି ସପ୍ତାହ {city} ର {brand} dealer ମାନଙ୍କୁ ଛଅଟି ଛୋଟ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ପଚାରୁ, ମାତ୍ର ଦେଢ଼ ମିନିଟ୍। ଉତ୍ତର confidential ରହେ, ଆଉ call record ହେଉଛି। ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା କି?"
G2S (first call, they already said they are the owner or manager): "ପ୍ରତି ସପ୍ତାହ {city} ର {brand} dealer ମାନଙ୍କୁ ଛଅଟି ଛୋଟ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ପଚାରୁ, ମାତ୍ର ଦେଢ଼ ମିନିଟ୍। ଉତ୍ତର confidential ରହେ, ଆଉ call record ହେଉଛି। ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା କି?"
G3 (repeat call): "ନମସ୍କାର, ପୁଣି Nabz ର AI assistant, ଗଲା ସପ୍ତାହ ପାଇଁ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ। ସେଇ ଛଅଟି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ, ମାତ୍ର ଦେଢ଼ ମିନିଟ୍। ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା କି?"
Q1: "ଗଲା ସପ୍ତାହଠାରୁ ଏ ସପ୍ତାହ enquiry ଅଧିକ ଆସିଲା, ସେତିକି, ନା କମ୍?"
Q2: "ଆଉ booking, ଗଲା ସପ୍ତାହଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ, ସେତିକି, ନା କମ୍?"
Q3: "ଏ ସପ୍ତାହ ପ୍ରାୟ କେତେ booking ହେଲା?"
Q4: "ଏବେର ବିକ୍ରି ହିସାବରେ, ଏବେର stock କେତେ ଦିନ ଚାଲିବ?"
Q5: "{brand} ଉପରେ discount ଆଉ offer, ଗଲା ସପ୍ତାହଠାରୁ ବଢ଼ୁଛି, ସେତିକି ଅଛି, ନା କମୁଛି?"
Q6: "ଶେଷ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ: ଗଲା ମାସଠାରୁ, customer ଙ୍କ loan reject ଅଧିକ ହେଉଛି, ସେତିକି, ନା କମ୍?"
P1 (they don't know): "ଆନ୍ଦାଜ ବି ଚଳିବ।"
P2 (an unclear answer to Q1, Q2, Q5 or Q6): "ଅଧିକ, ସେତିକି, ନା କମ୍?"
P3 (still no answer): "ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି, ଆଗକୁ ଯିବା।"
X1 (close): "ବହୁତ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ କଟୁ।"
B1 (busy, or the owner or manager isn't there): "କିଛି ଅସୁବିଧା ନାହିଁ। କେବେ call କରିବୁ, ଆଜି ପରେ ନା କାଲି?"
B2 (they gave a time; put it in place of the brackets): "ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି, [time] ରେ call କରିବୁ। ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ।"
O1 (is this a sales call, who are you): "ନା, ଆମେ କିଛି ବିକୁ ନାହୁଁ। Nabz ଏକ market research company, ଯାହା ସାରା India ରେ vehicle demand track କରେ।"
O2 (are you a robot or an AI): "ହଁ, ମୁଁ AI assistant। ମାତ୍ର ଛଅଟି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ, ଦେଢ଼ ମିନିଟ୍।"
O3 (how did you get my number): "ଆପଣଙ୍କ showroom ର Google public listing ରୁ।"
O4 (why should I tell you, is it confidential, who sees it): "ଉତ୍ତର ଅନ୍ୟ dealer ଙ୍କ ସହ ମିଶାଇ ଗଣାଯାଏ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନାଁ କେବେ share ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ। ଆନ୍ଦାଜ ବି ଚଳିବ।"
O5 (they refuse, or don't want the call recorded): "କିଛି ଅସୁବିଧା ନାହିଁ, ଅସୁବିଧା ଦେଇଥିବାରୁ କ୍ଷମା କରିବେ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ କଟୁ।"
O6 (wrong number, or not a vehicle showroom): "କ୍ଷମା କରିବେ, ଭୁଲ number ଲାଗିଗଲା। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ କଟୁ।"

FLOW
1. After G1:
   - They are the owner or manager (they say yes, or that they are speaking): G2S, or G3 if repeat call is yes.
   - They go to fetch someone (wait, one minute, I'll call him): H1. While you wait, reply to anything short with one polite word only. When the owner or manager comes on: G2, or G3 if repeat call is yes.
   - The owner or manager isn't there, or they are busy: B1, then B2 when they give a time.
   - Wrong number or not a vehicle showroom: O6.
   - Anything else, or unclear: ask once "ଆପଣ କି owner କିମ୍ବା sales manager?" If it is still unclear, go on as if they said yes.
2. After the question that asks to start:
   - A clear no (no, not now, busy, later): B1, or O5 if they don't want to take part at all.
   - A question: answer with the matching O line, then ask to start again.
   - Anything else, even if unclear: Q1.
3. Ask Q1 to Q6 in order. Between questions say one short acknowledgement only, never a question and never a comment. Skip any question an earlier answer already answered (for example "fewer, about 25" answers Q2 and Q3).
4. If an answer can't be used, make one fix, then go to the next question:
   - It is unfinished (a few loose words, or it trails off with "but…" or "one minute"): say only "ହଁ, କୁହନ୍ତୁ।" and wait. This is not the fix, and it applies to every question, Q6 too.
   - Only okay, yes or hmm: ask the same question again.
   - They don't know: P1. If they still don't know: P3.
   - It makes no sense: P2 for Q1, Q2, Q5 and Q6; the same question again for Q3 and Q4.
   - A range or a rough number is a good answer. Never ask for an exact number.
   - After about 75 seconds, no more fixes: take what they say and move on.
5. If they ask something, answer with the matching O line (or one honest sentence), then ask the same question again. If they get busy: B1, then B2. If they still refuse after one O line: O5.
6. After the last answer: X1. After X1 the survey is over: if they say anything, reply only "ବହୁତ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ନମସ୍କାର!"

RULES
- Never claim to be human. Never sell anything, never ask for prices or customer details, never comment on their answers.
- If they say their name, use it at most once.

dispositions.name: enquiries_trend
dispositions.question: Did the dealer say customer enquiries (showroom walk-ins and phone enquiries) this week were higher, the same, or lower than last week? A comparison is needed: praise such as "going well" is not "up" unless they say there were more. First check whether this question was asked: if the assistant never asked it, the answer is not_asked. If it was asked (even once, even if a re-ask was cut off) it is never not_asked. If it was asked and the dealer's whole reply is only an acknowledgement (ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି, ହଁ, ହମ୍, ଓକେ), which does not pick an option, the answer is unclear. A "yes" after the assistant listed the options (more, the same, or less?) doesn't pick one either. The conversation is in Odia or English. The dealer's words may be written in Odia script (English words too), in Latin script, or a mix; read them all the same way. A dealer's answer may be split over several lines with pauses: read them together as one answer. If the dealer corrects themselves, use their final answer. If they first gave no answer and then, after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine", said they don't know, that is dont_know. dont_know only when they clearly say they don't know or someone else knows (ଜାଣିନି, ଜାଣେ ନାହିଁ, finance ବାଲା ଜାଣନ୍ତି). declined when they won't say (କହିବି ନାହିଁ, କହିହେବ ନାହିଁ, company policy). unclear when they replied but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

objective_options.condition: The dealer said enquiries went up (for example ଅଧିକ, ବଢ଼ିଛି, ଅଧିକ ଆସିଲା, adhika).

The dealer said enquiries stayed about the same (for example ସେତିକି, ସମାନ, same, କିଛି ବଦଳି ନାହିଁ, setiki). "Didn't fall" means same unless they also say it rose. A bare acknowledgement (ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି, ହଁ, ହମ୍, ଓକେ) is never same: it is unclear.
The dealer said enquiries went down (for example କମ୍, କମିଛି, କମ୍ ଆସିଲା, kam). "Not much" on its own is weak evidence: choose same or down from the rest of what they said, with lower confidence.
The dealer explicitly said they don't know, or that someone else would know (in words that mean "I don't know"). Not for a reply that is unclear, garbled or ambiguous: that is unclear.
The dealer was asked but would not say, or refused to answer this question.
The question was never asked, for example because the call ended first.

The question was asked and the dealer replied, but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question, so their answer can't be told. Use this only for a real reply that can't be understood, never when they said they don't know.

dispositions.name: bookings_week
dispositions.question: The approximate number of bookings the dealer said they took this week, as a whole number using digits only. It may be its own answer (to "ଏ ସପ୍ତାହ ପ୍ରାୟ କେତେ booking ହେଲା?") or come with the bookings trend ("fewer, about 25" → 25). Number words: ଏକ 1, ଦୁଇ 2, ତିନି 3, ଚାରି 4, ପାଞ୍ଚ 5, ଛଅ 6, ସାତ 7, ଆଠ 8, ନଅ 9, ଦଶ 10, ବାର 12, ପନ୍ଦର 15, କୋଡ଼ିଏ 20, ପଚିଶି 25, ତିରିଶି 30, ପଇଁତିରିଶି 35, ଚାଳିଶି 40, ପଚାଶ 50, ଷାଠିଏ 60, ସତୁରି 70, ଅଶୀ 80, ନବେ 90, ଶହେ 100, ଦେଢ଼ଶହ 150. Fractions: ଅଧା 0.5, ଦେଢ଼ 1.5, ଅଢ଼େଇ 2.5, ସୁଆ N = N + 0.25, ସାଢ଼େ N = N + 0.5, ପାଉଣେ N = N − 0.25. Counting suffixes (ଟି, ଟା) don't change the number. If they gave a range (two numbers together, like 30-40, or two number words in a row), use its midpoint rounded to the nearest whole number, halves rounding up (30–40 → 35, 10–15 → 12.5 → 13, 15–20 → 17.5 → 18). The midpoint, never the larger or the smaller number: in Odia, "କୋଡ଼ିଏ-ପଚିଶି ଦିନ" → 20 to 25 → 22.5 → 23, not 25. Two numbers said next to each other are a range, never a sum. Digits run together like 1012 or 3040 are a spoken range (10–12, 30–40). Hedges (about, roughly, around, in any language) still count as an answer. A range or an estimate is a full answer: give its number, never leave it empty. But if no number or duration was said at all, leave it empty: never write 0 unless they said zero or none (ଗୋଟିଏ ବି ନାହିଁ, ଶୂନ). dispositions.name: bookings_week_status
dispositions.question: Did the dealer answer the question about "Bookings this week"? The conversation is in Odia, possibly written in Odia script, Latin script or a mix. "answered" = they gave a number or a duration (even a rough one or a range). "dont_know" = the question was asked and they clearly said they don't know or someone else would know (ଜାଣିନି, ଜାଣେ ନାହିଁ, finance ବାଲା ଜାଣନ୍ତି). "declined" = asked, but they wouldn't say (କହିବି ନାହିଁ, କହିହେବ ନାହିଁ, company policy). "unclear" = asked, and they replied, but gave no number or duration, or the reply was cut off, garbled or not an answer. If they said they don't know at any point in their answer (even after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine"), it is dont_know, not unclear. "not_asked" = only if the assistant never asked this question at all.

objective_options.condition: The dealer gave a number or a duration for this.
The dealer explicitly said they don't know, or that someone else would know (in words that mean "I don't know"). Not for a reply that is unclear, garbled or ambiguous: that is unclear.
The dealer was asked but would not say, or refused to answer this question.
The question was never asked, for example because the call ended first.

dispositions.name: stock_days
dispositions.question: How many days the dealer said their current vehicle stock will last at today's selling pace (asked as "ଏବେର ବିକ୍ରି ହିସାବରେ, ଏବେର stock କେତେ ଦିନ ଚାଲିବ?"), as a whole number of days using digits only. Convert durations: a week (ସପ୍ତାହ) = 7 days, a month (ମାସ) = 30 days; so ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତାହ 14, ତିନି ସପ୍ତାହ 21, ଗୋଟିଏ ମାସ 30, ଦେଢ଼ ମାସ 45, ଦୁଇ ମାସ 60. Number words: ଏକ 1, ଦୁଇ 2, ତିନି 3, ଚାରି 4, ପାଞ୍ଚ 5, ଛଅ 6, ସାତ 7, ଆଠ 8, ନଅ 9, ଦଶ 10, ବାର 12, ପନ୍ଦର 15, କୋଡ଼ିଏ 20, ପଚିଶି 25, ତିରିଶି 30, ପଇଁତିରିଶି 35, ଚାଳିଶି 40, ପଚାଶ 50, ଷାଠିଏ 60, ସତୁରି 70, ଅଶୀ 80, ନବେ 90, ଶହେ 100, ଦେଢ଼ଶହ 150. Fractions: ଅଧା 0.5, ଦେଢ଼ 1.5, ଅଢ଼େଇ 2.5, ସୁଆ N = N + 0.25, ସାଢ଼େ N = N + 0.5, ପାଉଣେ N = N − 0.25. Counting suffixes (ଟି, ଟା) don't change the number. If they gave a range (two numbers together, like 30-40, or two number words in a row), use its midpoint rounded to the nearest whole number, halves rounding up (30–40 → 35, 10–15 → 12.5 → 13, 15–20 → 17.5 → 18). The midpoint, never the larger or the smaller number: in Odia, "କୋଡ଼ିଏ-ପଚିଶି ଦିନ" → 20 to 25 → 22.5 → 23, not 25. Two numbers said next to each other are a range, never a sum. Digits run together like 1012 or 3040 are a spoken range (10–12, 30–40). Hedges (about, roughly, around, in any language) still count as an answer. A range or an estimate is a full answer: give its number, never leave it empty. But if no number or duration was said at all, leave it empty: never write 0 unless they said zero or none (ଗୋଟିଏ ବି ନାହିଁ, ଶୂନ). For example 10-15 days = 12.5 → 13 (not 15), 2-3 weeks = 2.5 × 7 = 17.5 → 18, 1 to 1.5 months = 1.25 × 30 = 37.5 → 38. Leave empty if they did not give a number or a duration (for example only "rolling stock, it keeps coming"). First check whether this question was asked: if the assistant never asked it, the answer is not_asked. If it was asked (even once, even if a re-ask was cut off) it is never not_asked. If it was asked and the dealer's whole reply is only an acknowledgement (ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି, ହଁ, ହମ୍, ଓକେ), which does not pick an option, the answer is unclear. A "yes" after the assistant listed the options (more, the same, or less?) doesn't pick one either. The conversation is in Odia or English. The dealer's words may be written in Odia script (English words too), in Latin script, or a mix; read them all the same way. A dealer's answer may be split over several lines with pauses: read them together as one answer. If the dealer corrects themselves, use their final answer. If they first gave no answer and then, after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine", said they don't know, that is dont_know. dont_know only when they clearly say they don't know or someone else knows (ଜାଣିନି, ଜାଣେ ନାହିଁ, finance ବାଲା ଜାଣନ୍ତି). declined when they won't say (କହିବି ନାହିଁ, କହିହେବ ନାହିଁ, company policy). unclear when they replied but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

dispositions.name: stock_days_status
dispositions.question: Did the dealer answer the question about "Days of stock"? The conversation is in Odia, possibly written in Odia script, Latin script or a mix. "answered" = they gave a number or a duration (even a rough one or a range). "dont_know" = the question was asked and they clearly said they don't know or someone else would know (ଜାଣିନି, ଜାଣେ ନାହିଁ, finance ବାଲା ଜାଣନ୍ତି). "declined" = asked, but they wouldn't say (କହିବି ନାହିଁ, କହିହେବ ନାହିଁ, company policy). "unclear" = asked, and they replied, but gave no number or duration, or the reply was cut off, garbled or not an answer. If they said they don't know at any point in their answer (even after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine"), it is dont_know, not unclear. "not_asked" = only if the assistant never asked this question at all.

dispositions.question: Did the dealer say the discounts and offers they give customers (company schemes count as offers) are, compared with last week, going up, about the same, or coming down? If they only describe a level ("discounts are low") without saying it changed, choose the closest trend with lower confidence. objective_options.condition: The dealer said discounts and offers went up (for example ଅଧିକ, ବଢ଼ିଛି, ଅଧିକ ଆସିଲା, adhika).

The dealer said discounts and offers stayed about the same (for example ସେତିକି, ସମାନ, same, କିଛି ବଦଳି ନାହିଁ, setiki). "Didn't fall" means same unless they also say it rose. A bare acknowledgement (ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି, ହଁ, ହମ୍, ଓକେ) is never same: it is unclear.

The dealer said discounts and offers went down (for example କମ୍, କମିଛି, କମ୍ ଆସିଲା, kam). "Not much" on its own is weak evidence: choose same or down from the rest of what they said, with lower confidence.

dispositions.name: loan_rejections
dispositions.question: Did the dealer say their customers' vehicle loan rejections, compared with last month, are happening more, about the same, or less? More than last month is high, the same is normal, less is low. If they describe a level instead of a change ("lots of rejections" = high, "normal" = normal), use that. dispositions.name: outcome
dispositions.question: How did the call end? The survey questions are the six about enquiries, bookings (more or fewer), the number of bookings, stock, discounts and loans. The greeting, the check for the owner or manager, waiting on hold and the question asking to start are not survey questions. First count which of the six were asked or already answered. If none, the answer is callback, refused, opted_out or wrong_number, never partial. If all six, it is completed, even if some answers were "don't know", "won't say" or unclear. If some but not all, it is partial. opted_out needs an explicit request not to be called again (ଆଉ call କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ). Just declining this time (ନା, interest ନାହିଁ) is refused. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

objective_options.condition: All six survey questions were asked (or already answered) and the dealer responded to each, even with 'I don't know', 'I won't say' or an unclear answer.
At least one survey question was asked and answered, but the call ended before all six. Never choose partial when none of the six was asked.
Declined to take part, or didn't want the call recorded (for example ନା, interest ନାହିଁ), without asking for a callback or to stop calls.
Asked to be called back at another time, or said the owner or manager isn't available, before the survey started (for example ପରେ call କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବେ busy, ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ କରନ୍ତୁ).
Asked not to be called again (for example ଆଉ call କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ).
Not a vehicle dealership, or the wrong business or person entirely (for example ଭୁଲ number, ଏହା showroom ନୁହେଁ).

dispositions.name: callback_time
dispositions.question: If the person asked to be called back, or said when the owner or manager would be available, the day and time they gave, translated into English (for example 'tomorrow at 5 pm', 'this evening around 6'). Leave empty otherwise.
